scope: Post-hoc BRISC internal-validation calibration; not clinical validation

method.name: single positive pixel temperature scaling
method.fit_objective: whole-image binary pixel NLL averaged equally over images
method.cross_fitting: five held-out folds; exact path-to-fold assignment reused from the accepted classifier calibration

binning.rationale: dense pixel probabilities concentrate near 0 and 1; equal-width bins retain visibility of the smaller middle-confidence range
binning.weighting: every image has equal total weight within each region

regions.lesion_centered: accepted 128x128 reference mask plus pixels within Euclidean distance 8 in model space; clipped at image boundaries

bootstrap.unit: similarity group with all member images retained

raw.binning: 15 fixed equal-width bins over [0,1] with image-balanced pixel weights

oof_calibrated.binning: 15 fixed equal-width bins over [0,1] with image-balanced pixel weights

gate.rule: All checks must pass; there is no metric tie-break.

limitations: The segmenter checkpoint was selected using this validation partition before calibration.
The proposed all-validation temperature is not used for reported metrics.
Reference masks define evaluation regions only and are unavailable at inference time.
Similarity groups are not verified patient identifiers.
Patient independence and cross-dataset generalization remain unverified.
